about: API route and save contracts of migrated execution cases, each from the test it moved from. From execution_completed_intermediates.rs and intermediate_result_kinds.rs at a71a3f4b6: check-only calls stay check-only, every build requires a domain except the first-template preparation refusal, and save booleans retain the original Ok(true) or failed-save assertions; inputs, expected diagnostics and saved bytes remain in completed_intermediates.json. From execution_retired_odm_context.rs at 3e8d5f6b5: a build its test unwrapped requires a domain, and one whose test accepted either outcome (either) may also be refused; a save its test asserted returns Ok(true) or fails, including the build case when_binds_groups_without_changing_the_fraction_denominator, whose test saved before reading the saved report; inputs, expected diagnostics, tables and saved bytes remain in odm_source_reads.json, row_derivations.json, row_intermediate_operands.json and row_scopes.json. From the saved helper of check_variable_forms.rs: every build required a domain without issues and Ok(true); its inputs, expected diagnostics and saved bytes remain in check_variable_forms.json. From the check-only tests of project_domain_submission.rs at a47519f5d: each check whose test asserted that it left a study path absent (output.csv, input.csv or dm.csv) stays check-only and preserves the staged study, with the project its case names; the two per-value codelist refusals at an entry's path carry the select-only test they cover. Their inputs and expected diagnostics remain in submission.json. From the run_report module of scalar_language.rs at a47519f5d: every build its test unwrapped requires a domain, and the one whose test took the refusal (an_intermediate_warning_needs_a_report_file) requires preparation; each save its test asserted returns Ok(true), including the build cases whose tests saved only to read report rows back, or fails having published only the report its case states as saved; inputs, expected diagnostics, tables, report rows and saved bytes remain in run_report.json. From the scalar_language and secondary_scalar_operands modules of scalar_language.rs at a47519f5d: every build its test unwrapped requires a domain and each refusal its test took with err() requires preparation; each save its test asserted returns Ok(true), or fails, a failed save keeping its issues and publishing nothing; inputs, expected diagnostics and saved bytes remain in scalar_operations. From the build and save tests of project_domain_submission.rs at ec6bfd39b: every build their tests made, on its project when the case names one, required a domain; a save they asserted refused fails and preserves the study, one they asserted returns Ok(true) and writes the bytes its case states, and the inventory builds their tests made without saving publish nothing. Their inputs, expected diagnostics and saved bytes remain in submission.json. From file_diagnostic_origins.rs at 5ed2d8a46: each build its test took as refused requires preparation and publishes no file, each its test unwrapped requires a domain, each save its test asserted returns Ok(true) or fails and leaves the study as staged, and the dictionary check whose test asserted it left input.csv absent stays check-only; inputs, expected diagnostics and saved bytes remain in file_origins.json. From specification_sources.rs and specification_reports.rs at 5ed2d8a46: a finding the test took from PreparedRun::prepare, or from preparing the document alone, requires preparation, and one it took from running the prepared run over the input requires a domain; neither test saved; inputs and expected diagnostics remain in specification_runs. From the case_item_order and check_output_validation modules of execution_aggregate_record_operations.rs at db988eb9c: a check and a build whose test accepted either outcome (either) and then asserted that no out.csv exists publish nothing, which covers each expression site of case_item_order_reports_req_0339_at_each_expression_site and each precision outside 0 through 18 with study data; a build their test unwrapped requires a domain, and its save returns Ok(true) and writes the bytes its case states, which covers the empty derivations and the precision endpoints and omission. Their inputs, expected diagnostics and saved bytes remain in case_item_order.json and check_output_validation.json. From the original_intermediate_verifications module of declaration_contract_vectors.rs at 5ed2d8a46: each check whose test asserted that it left never-read.csv and out.csv absent stays check-only and preserves the staged study; its inputs and expected diagnostics remain in declaration_vectors.json. From the four benchmark-copy tests of execution_retired_odm_context.rs's scoped_windows_checks module at 8323a87e4: each build their tests unwrapped requires a domain, and each save their save_csv helper asserted writes nothing before the save, returns Ok(true) and writes the bytes its case states; their inputs, expected diagnostics and saved bytes remain in row_scopes.json. From execution_column_window_drivers.rs at 144fc5559: each build whose test saved required a domain without issues and Ok(true); its inputs, expected diagnostics and saved bytes remain in window_drivers.json. From execution_lookup_read_contexts.rs and execution_implicit_join_absence.rs at 144fc5559: each refusal the first took as an error whether preparation refused the run or its built result held issues accepts either route, and a build that held issues refused its save and left out.csv absent; each first issue the second read required a domain. A save without issues either file asserted returns Ok(true) under lookup_model_keeps_first_findings_and_successful_save_returns. Their inputs, expected diagnostics, report rows and saved bytes remain in lookup_model.json. From execution_row_phase_reads.rs at 144fc5559: every build required a domain; each refused save failed and left out.csv absent, and each accepted one returned Ok(true) and wrote the bytes its case states, in check_row_phase_boundaries.json. From execution_key_lookup_reads.rs and execution_per_template_defaults.rs at 144fc5559: every build required a domain, and each save returned Ok(true) and wrote the bytes its case states, in suppressed_lookup_reads.json. From declaration_layer_composition.rs at 55276b420: each refusal its test took with unwrap_err() from prepare_specification requires preparation, so the check and the build of its staged study are refused before any run and publish nothing, and the one build its test unwrapped requires a domain whose save returns Ok(true) and writes the out.csv its case states; inputs, expected diagnostics and saved bytes remain in layer_composition.json. From the csv_precision module of table_arrow_table.rs at 55276b420: each prepared specification its tests ran requires a domain; the run with two decimals saves with Ok(true) and writes the bytes its case states, also after its input changes, and each refused run has no output and refuses every save, publishing nothing; inputs, expected diagnostics, output and saved bytes remain in csv_precision.json. From execution_value_semantics.rs, execution_key_selection_semantics.rs and execution_filtered_mapping_source.rs at 144fc5559: every build their tests made required a domain, except a_missing_first_match_value_does_not_skip_evaluating_a_later_one, whose test accepted either outcome (either); each save their tests asserted returns Ok(true) and writes the bytes its case states, or fails having published nothing, and each refused build their tests saved fails its save. The two build cases whose tests read back the report their failed save published, unique_counts_missing_values_as_one_repeated_combination and a_require_pattern_read_from_data_fails_although_when_exempts_the_row, state that report's rows and name its path under publishes: the refused save publishes that declared report alone. Inputs, expected diagnostics, report rows and saved bytes remain in value_semantics.json and key_selection.json. From scalar_declarative_text_replace.rs at 144fc5559: each save its tests unwrapped requires a domain and returns Ok(true); inputs, expected diagnostics, report rows and saved bytes remain in text_replace.json. From scalar_declarative_text_case.rs at 144fc5559: the four refused declared source types, whose test accepted either outcome (either), return no output when they return a domain. From scalar_declarative_text_pad.rs at 144fc5559: a present value at an unrepresentable width is refused before a domain is returned (preparation). Their inputs and expected diagnostics remain in text_case.json and text_pad.json. From the saved helpers of execution_intermediate_driver_columns.rs and execution_column_driver_bindings.rs at 144fc5559: each save required a domain without issues and Ok(true), and writes the out.csv its case states; their inputs, expected diagnostics and saved bytes remain in intermediate_driver_columns.json and column_driver_bindings.json. No engine output supplied these facts.
